title: Code Evolver | Less manual interaction, multiple tasks
text: Code Evolver reduces the need for repeated human interaction by coordinating agents across multiple development tasks. You provide the goal; the teams handle the workflow.

title: Analyzer Agent Team | From data to direction
text: Start with data. The Analyzer Agent Team examines its profile, identifies insights, and recommends a direction for improving your repository.

title: Code Evolver Agent Team | From direction to changes
text: Start with a direction. The Code Evolver Agent Team scans, plans, implements, reviews, and validates changes, turning your goal into repository improvements.

title: Visit https://github.com/caigen/CodeEvolver
text: Explore Code Evolver on GitHub. Visit github dot com, slash caigen, slash Code Evolver. Use your own direction or feedback data to guide your next repository improvement.
